subject: info-af-b
title: INFO.AF.B.------C.FO.ACT.
description: Diagram in PCC-23, the first of two on book p339. (C)INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) is crossed with C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism). The diagram pairs the *informational* and *active* poles directly. INFO-AF-B → C-FO-ACT (the crossing). INFO-AF-B → (R)INT (the reality of intention) → PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From PROJ-DY a long line runs to PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), which branches to PR-TRS, from which RT-T branches, and to SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From SOC-RT-DY a single chain runs: SOC-RT-DY → DEC (decentralization) → RE-ST (restructuralism) → POL-DYM (political dynamics) → GRAD (gradualism) → PHY-U-P (physical universe particular).
